plain.li: Do you remember {LABEL}, all of us at the table?
[first] I'd forgotten half of what happened until I heard {LABEL}.
I had to look away when the names were read, at {LABEL}.

warm.li: {LABEL} made me glad I'm here with all of you.

blunt.li: {LABEL} went on a bit, didn't it.

plain.li: I didn't know it had been such a full year until I heard it all at once.
I liked hearing it read out, it made it feel like it counted.
I was waiting to hear my name, and then I was embarrassed when I did.
It was quieter at that table than I've ever heard it.

warm.li: I'm glad someone writes it all down.

blunt.li: It was fine, I was hungry.

plain.li: Let's hope next year's is a good one to read.
I want to be in next year's for something good.
We'll hear the next one soon enough.
